entries.finding: prose says edge cost balances length, scenic interest and repeat penalty and lists lambda1-3, but displayed W=-lambda2*S+lambda3*R contains no length/lambda1 term
earlier Cost(P) is scenic-interest/repeat edge sum, while GA fitness denominator is described using path length and repetition, dropping the scenic component from the visible fitness definition
one-point crossover and random unused-node replacement do not preserve graph adjacency by construction; final repair/constraint replay is underspecified
paper claims improved GA, printed path optimizer is dijkstra_adj() and contains no genetic loop

entries.surface: paper Sec.5.4 vs printed exoticness code
entries.finding: printed exoticness counts nearby element types, divides by segment length and log1p-compresses; this is not the paper's full composition/area/distance weighting model
abstract says best route has better interest; Sec.5.8 says official route is better on turns/scenic change and overall interest scores are similar
paper GMM-MRF/EM/ICM/BIC model is absent; code uses coordinate-only KMeans/MiniBatchKMeans
openness is np.random.random() and assumed score arrays are used in nominal validation path
paper searches K by BIC under GMM-MRF; code hard-codes K=5/6 and separately scans KMeans K by unrelated diagnostics
Jichang supplies thresholds/reference and is forced to 100, so its own rank/score cannot independently validate the model
all ten published comprehensive scores replay from 0.45*element+0.55*open-close to one decimal
scores is indexed by alpha scenarios, but np.argsort(scores) is called a garden ranking and compared with np.argsort(total_scores), whose axis is gardens
mu±1.96*sigma uses perturbation-score SD; absent an SE/estimand clarification this is not a confidence interval for the mean, at most a Normal distribution/reference interval
feature vector mixes route lengths/counts and bounded proportions; visible method does not expose fitted standardization before cosine, so unit-scale dominance is unresolved
training cohort uses set Jaccard on thresholded dominant-element sets; Heyuan equation uses sum(min)/sum(max), a continuous weighted min-max coefficient
alpha≈0.7 is selected on the same ten gardens using internal clustering/stability criteria; this is model selection/internal stability, not external aesthetic validity
Heyuan has no independent target similarity/aesthetic truth; applying the pipeline and obtaining plausible neighbors is applicability/face validity rather than accuracy proof
Heyuan similarity Series is hard-coded and two negative values are individually changed -0.791→0.209 and -0.857→0.143 without a registered global transform
no cosine/Jaccard/alpha-scan similarity computation is printed; only contour extraction and fixed plotting data appear
visual PDF confirms F_fusion = 1 - |A_natural/A_total - A_artificial/A_total|; text extraction omitted the absolute bars

global_gates: route genetic operators require feasibility-preserving representation or final decoded-route replay
all named objective components must appear in the displayed/executable objective registry
paper spatial-model labels require actual likelihood/adjacency/optimization primitives
sensitivity ranking arrays must share the same entity axis and run identifiers
heterogeneous similarity features require scale/preprocessing contract
set Jaccard and continuous min/max similarity must be named distinctly
external application without independent truth is applicability evidence, not accuracy/generalization proof
post-hoc pair-specific similarity edits invalidate result provenance
visual PDF inspection overrides lossy text extraction for equation symbols
